text:
maria: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off the quarterly access review next Mon. Focus: admin entitlements, KMS principals, and audit-hook coverage. Need a short plan + owners. Anyone tackled automated owner-proof for service accounts recently?
ben: yes — we built a quick query and owner tagger last quarter. not perfect but reduces manual. gist link: https://gist.github.com/redwood/owner-proof-sql :point_right:
aisha: I can run the initial scan if we agree on filters. will use access-lint and tag false-positives in the GH issue. command: `./scripts/access_lint.sh --scope=prod --roles="*admin*"` :thumbsup:
ben: sample query we used:
```sql
SELECT svc_account, current_owner, role, last_used_at
FROM iam_bindings
WHERE role LIKE '%admin%'
  AND last_used_at > now() - interval '90 days';
```
sec-bot: FYI — runbook link added to thread: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/access-review (added by sec-bot) :bookmark:
diego: couple Qs — do we include cross-account KMS grants in the same sweep? infra has a few delegated keys that are purposely admin-ish. we should whitelist by key_tag=infra:true
hema: yes include KMS, but treat it as separate remediation flow. propose: 1) detect ownerless/admin bindings, 2) create a canary PR that removes non-prod entitlements for 10 svc accts, 3) monitor audit logs for 48h. KMS query (simple):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:... 
```
paul: timeline? I'd prefer we do scans Tue-Wed, remediations Thu, and a final pass next Mon. also suggest we set an alert in Observability for any auth failures above baseline :eyes:
maria: plan sounds good. Volunteers: aisha runs scans (Tue AM), ben prepares owner-proof script and whitelist logic, hema writes the canary PR template, diego to produce the infra whitelist (KMS tags). paul will set the alert and oncall watch. I'll file the GH issue and add owners.
ben: I'll add a small fallback in the script to re-add if audit shows service disruption — `--dry-run` first, then `--apply` after approval.
aisha: starting scan Tue 09:30 PT, I'll paste raw CSV to the issue and tag owners.
sec-bot: Reminder: make sure all KMS key policies have `kms:GrantUsage` logging enabled per policy v2.0 — see policy diff: https://redwood.internal/policies/kms-v2.0.md
diego: re: exempt list — I'll upload infra_exempt.json to the issue with key_tag and justification fields.
hema: small note: for high-risk admin roles (org-admin, billing-admin) require 2 approvals on the canary PR. add that to the template.
paul: created alert: AccessReview/SpikeAuthFailures — threshold set to +3 sigma over last 30d. will share dashboard link in the issue.
maria: assigning GH #4521, linking runbook and this thread. objectives in the issue: scan, whitelist, canary PR, monitor 48h, rollback plan. anything else? :thinking:
ben: include a step to export audit logs to long-term storage before remediations (for postmortem).
aisha: ok — will capture logs and attach.
maria: great. thanks everyone. ping me in thread if you hit blockers. :raised_hands:
